title: The hunter promises 'Clear the pack out proper and I'll call the debt paid before you ever show me a pelt' for the wolf-pack quest (Warden-only option). I killed the lean wolf and the gaunt wolf and later showed both trophies to the hunter (each time he reacted warmly and paid herbs+gold), but no 'Quest done' line for that quest ever appeared, and he never said the debt was settled. Unclear whether the promise was actually honored by the game state.
where: Hunter's Camp / 'take the wolf pack on yourself (as a Warden)'
